description_en: Moves a WAF resource to a different resource group
description_zh: 将一个WAF资源转移到其他资源组
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi move-resource-group --resource-id 'waf-cn-09k1rd50000~www.example.com' --resource-group-id rg-atstuj3rtop0000 --resource-type domain --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF resource to move.

After you configure a Website Config for a domain name in WAF, the domain name represents a WAF resource. A WAF resource uses a resource ID (ResourceId) as its unique identity in Resource Management. The resource ID of a WAF resource is in the format of `<InstanceId>~<Domain>`:

`<InstanceId>` specifies the ID of the current WAF instance. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation in the WAF API to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

`<Domain>` specifies the website domain name that is added to the WAF instance for protection. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html operation in the WAF API to query all domain names added to the WAF instance for protection.

`<InstanceId>` and `<Domain>` are connected by `~` to form the resource ID of the WAF domain name resource
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的WAF资源的ID。

您将网站域名接入WAF防护后，则该域名表示一个WAF资源。WAF资源在资源管理服务中使用资源ID（ResourceId）作为其唯一标识，WAF资源ID的命名方式为：`<InstanceId>~<Domain>`。具体说明如下：

`<InstanceId>`表示当前WAF实例的ID。您可以调用WAF API中的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html接口，查询当前WAF实例的ID。

`<Domain>`表示已接入WAF实例防护的网站域名。您可以调用WAF API中的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html接口，查询所有已接入WAF实例防护的域名。

`<InstanceId>`和`<Domain>`之间使用`~`连接，即表示WAF域名资源的资源ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the WAF resource.

After you create a resource group in Resource Management, a unique identifier is generated for the resource group, which is the resource group ID (ResourceGroupId).

You can view all resource group IDs on the Resource Group page in the Resource Management console (https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups), or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html operation provided by Resource Management to query all resource group IDs
parameters.help_zh:
WAF资源要转入的资源组的ID。

您通过资源管理服务创建资源组后，资源管理服务会为资源组生成一个唯一标识，即资源组ID（ResourceGroupId）。

您可以在资源管理控制台 (https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups)的资源组页面，查询所有资源组ID；或者调用资源管理服务提供的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html接口，查询所有资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the WAF resource. Set the value to domain, which indicates that the WAF resource type is domain name only
parameters.help_zh: WAF资源的类型。唯一取值：domain，表示WAF的资源类型仅为域名
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the request ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
